purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Ainamoi Form 34B final TOTAL row and preserve a partially-explained denominator gap without promotion.

sample.review_context_note: Full official-page raster rendered directly from the freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF (no third-party crop pipeline or CI artifact involved), then re-cropped and upscaled around the TOTAL row for digit-level confirmation. This constituency's downloaded Form 34B is a 4-page document (page 4 of 4 ends in the TOTAL row, followed by the agent-signature/handover block on the same page). The page header banner reads 'CON 190 04/12'. The portal only served this PDF after a home-page + set-election session handshake (id=5).

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session (via the governed form_id = constituency_code + 277628 locator, after resetting the portal session from its default by-election context to the 2022 general election via index.php?r=common/set-election&id=5), its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values. Constituency identity (AINAMOI, code 190) was read from the polling-station-code prefixes ('035190...') and cross-checked against the visible 'CON 190' banner marker printed on the TOTAL-row page itself before this row was accepted.

registered_voters.note: The printed TOTAL row's Registered Voters figure is 85,246, which is 222 more than the governed P23 constituency denominator (85,024). The two rows immediately above TOTAL are '049292145108201 KERICHO MAIN' (registered 46) and '049292145108401 KERICHO ANNEX' (registered 13), non-ward polling-station codes ('049292...') matching the recurring special-facility (prison) numbering pattern documented elsewhere in this Atlas -- together they account for only 59 of the 222 delta. The remaining 163 is not explained by any other non-standard code visible on the pages served in this download, so the gap is only partially attributed and is preserved unresolved rather than assumed.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.

row_reconciliation.governed_p23_registered_voters_source: KDA-VOTERS-CON-190-2022 (data/indicators/registry/observations.json), exact sum of official IEBC child ward rows

note: Total Valid Votes, Rejected Ballots and the four candidate cells are individually clear and internally reconcile on the printed TOTAL row (candidate sum 62,925 = printed Total Valid Votes). However, the row's own printed Registered Voters figure (85,246) does not exactly match the separately governed P23 registered-voter denominator for this constituency (85,024), a gap of 222. Two non-ward special-facility polling stations visible on this page (KERICHO MAIN and KERICHO ANNEX, matching the recurring prison/national-facility code pattern documented elsewhere in this Atlas) together account for only 59 of that gap, leaving 163 unexplained by anything visible in this download. Per the extraction contract's exact-reconciliation requirement for registered_voters and its prohibition on inferring unverified explanations, this row is preserved unresolved and no turnout observation may be promoted from this evidence until the denominator conflict is independently reconciled by the governed P23 registered-voters denominator process.
